payload.title: Build exact-model compatibility evidence and deterministic rules
payload.goal: Make fit conclusions traceable to specific manufacturer models and dated dimensions rather than generalized thresholds.
payload.owner_role: Designated Windows release parent assigns one admitted implementation owner; separate exact-source reviewer; existing scheduled operator retains integration/effect ownership
implementation_steps: Define toilet/bidet model IDs and revisions, region, dimensions/units/tolerance, geometry, mounting/plumbing/power requirements, source URL/document/page, retrieval date/hash, reviewed claims and unknowns.

Seed a bounded representative set from current primary manufacturer drawings: normal round/elongated plus French-curve/skirted exceptions; each record includes supported, conflicting or unknown conclusion.
Require two-person/source-domain review of extracted facts; retailer guidance remains secondary and physical testing is never inferred.
Implement unit conversion and product-specific checks; stale, missing or contradictory decisive dimensions downgrade to needs-verification and name the missing measurement.
Generate comparison facts from evidence without using commission rate in fit ranking; preserve source revisions and correction history.
tests: Metric/imperial, boundary tolerance, incomplete dimension, model alias and conflicting source fixtures return deterministic conservative conclusions.
Removing required source or expiring it prevents a supported exact-model result.
Reviewer independently traces each seeded numerical requirement to primary source locator and extraction hash.

review.identity_requirement: Reviewer-authored record with actual reviewer identity, model/effort and host; distinct-model qualification is required for runtime/release acceptance and is not supplied by this plan.
review.exact_source: Bind immutable implementation commit, task/spec hash, artifact hashes, executed test receipts and any destination receipt. New source invalidates prior approval.
review.bounded_repairs: At most two targeted repair/review cycles; unresolved findings become a linked blocked task, preserving attempts.

acceptance: Each exact-model result has dated source links and a reason; unsupported fit guarantees are absent.
Unknown or conflicting evidence produces a useful next measurement/manufacturer-verification step.
payload.rollback: Revert affected evidence revision/rules to last reviewed snapshot; downgrade dependent results to uncertain and retain corrections.
payload.next_eligible_action: Implement source/schema fixture and seed a bounded manufacturer-grounded model set.

estimate.assumptions: New planning range for admitted implementation and bounded review; reuses evidenced assets; excludes observation waiting, non-delegable account work and shared-platform implementation. Not a replacement for historical Jira estimates or measured actuals.
estimate.dependency_risk: Primary drawings may be inaccessible; represent unavailable models as unknown rather than delaying schema or inventing facts.
